building_name: 61 West 23rd Street (Zegna family; Taconic development partner)
notes: Seven-story building between Fifth and Sixth Aves owned by the Zegna family (CO 2026-09-21). 2026 full-floor leases: Inspiren (moved in Sept 2026) and Normal Computing (moving Nov 2026, about 30 staff). An 8,367 sf lease here in 2023 (REBusiness 2023-04-11) was reported by CO as The Action Network, but Built In now lists that company's HQ at 275 Madison Ave, so it is not recorded.

13-story, 341,000 sf Beaux-Arts loft building, fully leased per Two Trees (NYREJ 2025-10-14): 'newly renovated lobby with a 24/7 attendant', bicycle entry, rooftop garden. Tenants: BuzzFeed HQ, Foursquare HQ, MSQ Partners NA HQ, Instacart, Trustpilot, BMF, Curex (small), Clinch (2023 lease; Built In now lists Clinch HQ at 37 W 20th St).

49 and 53 West 23rd St geocode to the same tax lot (bbl 1008250012). 53 W 23rd: 12 stories, tenants Huge (8), TileBar (3-4), LaForce (PR), P.C. Richard & Son ground-floor retail (CO 2025-10-02). 49 W 23rd: AI One (about 20 staff per Built In), Publishers Weekly, JB Drax Honore, a dentist, The Pack gym (CO 2025-12-12). theSkimm is listed at 53 W 23rd on Built In but its legal pages point to parent Ziff Davis/Everyday Health at 360 PAS, so not recorded here. Adams & Co site (live): 53 W 23rd is one of three attached buildings in its '23rd Street Complex' (with 49 W 23rd and 30 W 24th); lobby renovated 2018, '24/7 guard service', 'card-access controlled with turnstiles', 3 passenger and 2 freight elevators; 49 W 23rd also lists 24/7 guard and 1 freight elevator.
Eight-story building one block west of the Flatiron Building; 100% leased after Chalk's 26,607 sf lease (CO 2026-07).

About 1.4M sf tower a block south of Madison Square Park; 100% leased Q1 2026 (Flatiron NoMad Partnership). Tenants: IBM (362,092 sf), Harvey (185,326 sf), Sigma Computing (64,077 sf), plus Franklin Templeton, Coinbase, Flutter Entertainment and Palo Alto Networks (SL Green release 2025-07-16). Building amenities page (1madisonnyc.com, live): tenant lounge 'The Commons' with 'L'Epicerie at One Madison, Daniel Boulud grab-n-go cafe' and a rooftop grab-n-go cafe and bar, which may compete with an office pantry. Lobby security not described.

Major tenants: PitchBook, Harvey AI; also Bluefish (8th floor, about 29 staff per Built In), Cadre and Amazon (CO 2026-02). Equinox, Tatte, Just Salad at street level.

12-story building on Madison Square Park at W 25th St, owned by Adams & Co since Aug 2023 (CO 2026-01-08). Tenants: Purple PR (full floor, 2026), Wellcom Worldwide, Pilot Fiber (12), Raycon (12; about 35 staff per Built In, not recorded), Green Mountain Energy NYC office. Adams & Co site (live): 12 floors, 3 passenger and 4 freight elevators, '24/7 Guard' and '24/7 security'.
Six-story, about 17,000 sf building bought by Japanese publisher Kodansha (FNP Feb 2024 roundup citing Crain's).

building_name: 11 Madison Avenue (SL Green); Sony Music uses 25 Madison Ave entrance
notes: 30-story full-block tower between E 24th and E 25th St, Madison Ave to PAS; 100% leased (CO 2026-07-23). Wikipedia: three-story main lobby, four corner entrances plus a mid-block 24th St entrance, and 'numerous loading docks' on the 25th Street side (security desk not described, so lobby_type set to loading dock). Tenants: Sony (Sony Music uses 25 Madison Ave; CO Oct 2026 reports Sony in talks to anchor 99 Hudson Blvd), UBS, Jim Beam Brands (Suntory Global Spirits), WME, Pinterest (13), Tempus AI, Clay (14-16, from 2026), Legora (11, from 2026), Madison Square Park Conservancy (15). Yelp was a tenant per a 2017 citation on Wikipedia (not recorded).

Williams Equities building page (live): restored cast-iron facade and 'three attended lobbies'. Ramp expanded to 285,300 sf here per Metro Manhattan (Jun 2026, citing TRD Apr 2026). Williams Equities got a 155M CMBS loan on 28-40 W 23rd (FNP May 2024 roundup).
Touched: Built In lists Betterment HQ '8 w 24th streeet, 6th Floor', but Betterment's own site footer now gives 450 West 33rd Street, so no company recorded here.

Betches Media's former office; Betches is relocating to 360 PAS 6th floor (CO 2026-03-16). The Maze (alcohol-free members club) signed 4,600 sf here (FNP Aug 2025 roundup).
